nom: RoC Derm Correxion Dual Eye Cream with Advanced Retinol + Peptides

segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin report eyelid swelling, chemical burn, or peeling the morning after use, with one warning others with sensitive skin to avoid the product.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s with fine lines, hooded eyes, dark circles, or crow's feet report visible firming, softened lines, and brighter under-eyes with regular use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using this for fine lines, wrinkles, crow's feet, or hooded eyes report visible softening, firming, or a more lifted lid, some within one to two weeks; a few see no notable change yet and say more time is needed.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the under-eye cream leaves skin soft, hydrated, and smooth through the day; one reviewer says other products dried her skin but this one did not.
concerns.redness: One reviewer had initial redness and irritation that subsided with reduced frequency; another reported a chemical burn and swelling and advises against use on sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers note peeling or irritation on the eyelid area with the gel, including one who could only tolerate the under-eye cream after skin peeled the morning after using the gel.
concerns.oiliness: Some reviewers say the formula absorbs without greasiness or shine; one reviewer with normal-to-combination concerns found it made her skin greasy and noted separation after drying.

aspects.libelle: Flaking or white residue after drying
Pilling or caking under makeup or sunscreen
Cooling, smooth gel texture on eyelid

Two-in-one jar design for lid and under-eye

extraits.titre: Avoid if you have sensitive skin
extraits.texte: The cream and gel made my eyes swell and gave me a chemical burn. If you have sensitive skin, avoid this product.

extraits.titre: Great product, needs a more gentle eyelid gel
extraits.texte: I received a free product from RoC in exchange for my honest review. I found that the jar was well designed, keeping the eyelid cream/gel separate from the cream meant for the undereye/whole eye area. I did find that my eyelids were a tad too sensitive for the formula and each time that I used it, my skin would peel the following morning, so I ended up only using the eye cream. The cream did a nice job of firming up my undereye area and seemed to also help with dark circles (thank you genetics).

I'm currently in my early 40s and starting to pay just a bit more attention to the lines, dark circles and wrinkles that are starting to form. My Grandmother has always taken really good care of her skin and I strive to have skin like her when I get older. When I first used this eye cream, I did have a bit of redness and irritation, so I reduced the frequency of use. After consistent use I was able to get past the irritation and can use it as per the recommend directions with no issues. While I do think I'm seeing less puffy areas around my eyes, I am not entirely sure it's worth the cost. Rating the 4 due to the initial irritation that I personally had at first as well as the cost if I would continue to use it long term. I received the RoC Derm Correxion Dual Eye Cream with Advanced Retinol + Peptides complimentary from RoC and Pinchme in exchange for my open and honest review.

extraits.titre: Good product. Worth giving it a try
extraits.texte: After using for a month, I won't be throwing it in the trash like I do most products. The skin around my eyes still feels soft and hydrated at the end of the day. Most other products eventually dries my skin but this was a far different story. The gel that goes above the eyes is very cooling, the cream is smooth. It all absorbs well without being greasy. Makeup applied over it went on well too

Overall just wasnt a winner for me. Had high hopes after readinf reviews. Ended up returning. Made my skin greasy and the product kind of seperated after it dried. Just didnt work with my skin. The container is so small for what you pay.

extraits.titre: I got great results from this eye product!
extraits.texte: I am 51 and have hooded eyes, something that is genetic with my family. I used this product for a month and had great results! I like that it has separate products for upper eye and under eye: upper eye is a gel that tightens and under eye is a richer cream that really minimized the crows feet lines I had developing. I'm definitely going to buy this to use again once I run out. I received this free from RoC for my honest opinion.

I received this product for free as part of a product trial and I am impressed! I have dark circles and puffiness under my eyes and this is the best cream I've tried (and I've tried a lot). It did not get rid of the darkness completely, it did lighten it quite a bit. To be fair, I only was able to try this for a couple of weeks so far, so I'm not sure if that will improve. It completely removed my puffiness and I am overall very satisfied.
